gameDescriptionHtml:
A new experience where the story meets rhythm. KALPA: Cosmic Symphony is a next-generation rhythm game crafted with beautiful characters, a vast story, and a diverse range of music and ways to play them. Jump in and experience the moment your performance changes the world.

Experience the moment your performance becomes the final melody.

Game Features

  • Charming Characters and an In-Depth Story – Meet a cast of beautiful and charming characters, each with their own unique personalities and backstories. Full-fledged story chapters of exceptional quality. Customize your own player avatar and more with characters featured in the story though the Companion feature.
  • A Massive Tracklist – Featuring original songs from renowned composers, exclusive to KALPA, alongside legendary fan-favorites that will be familiar to any rhythm game enthusiast.
  • A Variety of Play Modes – KALPA’s diverse range of modes provides a constant stream of new fun, ensuring every player can find a style that’s perfect for them.
  • Introducing Astra Mode – Composer Charts: Play charts created by the very artists who composed the music for KALPA. Ranker Charts: Challenge yourself with charts designed by rankers recognized for their skill in other rhythm games. Content That Grows with the Community: By involving not only our development team but also key figures from the rhythm game scene, we’ve added a new level of depth and quality.
  • The KALPA Experience – An experience that goes beyond mere score-chasing, where the performance itself drives the story forward. A cosmic fantasy woven together with charming characters, grand visuals, and a symphonic OST. A moment where your choices and your performance will change the fate of the world.

Included DLCs:

  • Rizline Collaboration Pack
  • First Forte Pack
  • Lanota Collaboration Pack
  • Deeeer Simulator Collaboration Pack
  • SixtarGate Collaboration Pack
  • Phigros Collaboration Pack
  • Mass Recall Omega
